blocks.en: Section 4: Additional Considerations & References

blocks.zh: PDA TR86 — Sections 6.0–9.0 | 第6.0至9.0節
blocks.en: PDA TR86 — Sections 6.0–9.0

blocks.zh: Pages p38–p52 | 頁碼 p38–p52
blocks.en: Pages p38–p52

blocks.zh: Section Contents | 本節目錄
blocks.en: Section Contents

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives | 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 完成本節學習後，您將能夠：
blocks.en: After completing this section, you will be able to:

blocks.zh: 識別流通配送中的壓力因子（衝擊、振動、氣壓），以及相關標準（ISTA、ASTM）
blocks.en: Identify the stressors in the distribution chain (shock, vibration, pressure) and the relevant standards (ISTA, ASTM)

blocks.zh: 說明100%在線CCIT的概念與優勢，相較統計抽樣的差異
blocks.en: Explain the concept and advantages of 100% in-line CCIT compared with statistical sampling

blocks.zh: 應用QbD原則，建立完整的容器密封完整性測試（CCIT）計畫
blocks.en: Apply QbD principles to build a complete container closure integrity testing (CCIT) program

blocks.zh: 描述大量/單次使用容器的生命週期方法與各階段測試需求
blocks.en: Describe the lifecycle approach for bulk/single-use containers and the testing needs at each stage

blocks.zh: 使用陽性/陰性對照族群詮釋方法LOD研究，並以統計方式定義偵測極限
blocks.en: Interpret the method LOD study using positive/negative control populations, and define the detection limit statistically

blocks.zh: 說明TR86的貢獻，以及如何延伸USP <1207>處理複雜包裝系統
blocks.en: Explain the contribution of TR86 and how it extends USP <1207> to complex packaging systems

blocks.zh: 6.0 Additional Considerations for Package Integrity Profiling | 包裝完整性概況分析的額外考量
blocks.en: 6.0 Additional Considerations for Package Integrity Profiling

blocks.zh: Lifecycle stressors from manufacturing through distribution | 從製造到配送的生命週期壓力因子
blocks.en: Lifecycle stressors from manufacturing through distribution

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 第6.0節
blocks.en: Commentary — Section 6.0

blocks.zh: 一個穩健的包裝完整性概況（Package Integrity Profile），必須考量產品-包裝系統在整個生命週期中可能承受的所有因子，這是USP <1207>的要求。包裝完整性概況必須涵蓋預期或實際發生的壓力，包括：
blocks.en: A robust Package Integrity Profile must take into account all the factors the product-package system may be exposed to over its entire lifecycle; this is a USP <1207> expectation. The package integrity profile must cover the stresses that are expected or that actually occur, including:

blocks.zh: 震動（Shock/Vibration）：運輸途中物理撞擊
blocks.en: Shock/Vibration: physical impact during transport

blocks.zh: 壓縮（Compression）：堆疊儲存造成的壓力
blocks.en: Compression: pressure from stacked storage

blocks.zh: 溫度（Temperature）：冷鏈與溫度偏差
blocks.en: Temperature: cold chain and temperature excursions

blocks.zh: 氣壓（Pressure）：航空運輸中的低壓環境
blocks.en: Pressure: the low-pressure environment of air transport

blocks.zh: 儲存環境（Storage Environment）：濕度、紫外線等
blocks.en: Storage Environment: humidity, UV light, etc.

blocks.zh: 生活比喻
blocks.en: Everyday Analogy

blocks.zh: 「包裝完整性概況」就像一本護照，記錄這個產品-包裝系統從「出生」（開發）到「退休」（使用後）的每段旅程及考驗。監管機構要求你能說清楚：這個包裝在人生每個階段是否仍然完整？
blocks.en: The "package integrity profile" is like a passport: it records every journey and ordeal of the product-package system from "birth" (development) to "retirement" (after use). Regulators expect you to be able to explain clearly: is this package still intact at every stage of its life?

blocks.zh: 6.1 Transportation and Distribution | 運輸與配送
blocks.en: 6.1 Transportation and Distribution

blocks.zh: Distribution chain stressors unique to each product-package system | 每個產品-包裝系統獨特的配送鏈壓力
blocks.en: Distribution chain stressors unique to each product-package system

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 第6.1節
blocks.en: Commentary — Section 6.1

blocks.zh: 配送壓力因子會因劑型、包裝形式、產品特性和配送鏈不同而有極大差異。以溫度偏差為例，對某些蛋白質製劑可能是致命的，但對另一類產品卻幾乎無影響。
blocks.en: Distribution stressors vary enormously with dosage form, package format, product characteristics and distribution chain. A temperature excursion, for example, can be fatal to some protein formulations yet have almost no effect on another type of product.

blocks.zh: 重要提醒：完整性≠產品品質全部
blocks.en: Important reminder: integrity is not the whole of product quality

blocks.zh: TR86的重點是包裝完整性，但務必記得：一個在物理上完整（沒有洩漏）的包裝，仍可能因震動導致蛋白質聚集（aggregation）等品質問題。因此除了CCIT之外，還需要進行其他品質評估（如SE-HPLC測定蛋白質聚集）。
blocks.en: TR86 focuses on package integrity, but remember that a package that is physically intact (no leak) can still suffer quality problems, such as protein aggregation caused by vibration. In addition to CCIT, other quality assessments are therefore needed (for example, SE-HPLC to measure protein aggregation).

blocks.zh: 配送圈（Distribution Circuit）概念
blocks.en: The Distribution Circuit Concept

blocks.zh: 「配送圈」包含從製造廠出發，經過倉儲、批發商、物流中心、零售藥局，一直到患者手中的整個旅程。每個環節的壓力條件都應被評估並納入完整性概況中。
blocks.en: The "distribution circuit" covers the whole journey from the manufacturing site through warehouses, wholesalers, logistics centers and retail pharmacies to the patient. The stress conditions at every link should be evaluated and incorporated into the integrity profile.

blocks.zh: 6.1.1 Physical Stressors | 物理壓力因子
blocks.en: 6.1.1 Physical Stressors

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 第6.1.1節
blocks.en: Commentary — Section 6.1.1

blocks.zh: 物理壓力因子是配送中最直觀的風險，但危害程度差異很大：
blocks.en: Physical stressors are the most intuitive risk in distribution, but the degree of harm varies widely:

blocks.zh: 「潛伏性風險」的概念
blocks.en: The Concept of "Latent Risk"

blocks.zh: 細裂紋（check）的危險在於它是一個「時間炸彈」：在製造時可能僅是微小缺陷，但在配送過程中可能擴大成裂縫，最終導致微生物侵入（microbial ingress）或藥液滲漏。這就是為何必須評估整個包裝系統（一次、二次、三次包裝）。
blocks.en: The danger of a check (fine crack) is that it is a "time bomb": at manufacture it may be only a minor defect, but during distribution it can grow into a crack and ultimately lead to microbial ingress or leakage of the drug solution. This is why the entire packaging system (primary, secondary and tertiary packaging) must be evaluated.

blocks.zh: ISTA 標準
blocks.en: ISTA Standards

blocks.zh: ISTA（International Safe Transit Association）提供一系列標準化的配送模擬測試，其中ISTA 2A是常用的運輸模擬標準，涵蓋振動、衝擊、堆疊壓縮等測試條件，可重現陸運、航空等不同配送鏈。
blocks.en: ISTA (International Safe Transit Association) provides a series of standardized distribution simulation tests. ISTA 2A is a commonly used transport simulation standard covering test conditions such as vibration, shock and stacking compression, and it can reproduce different distribution chains such as road and air transport.

blocks.zh: 6.1.2 Pressure | 氣壓變化
blocks.en: 6.1.2 Pressure

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 第6.1.2節
blocks.en: Commentary — Section 6.1.2

blocks.zh: 航空運輸是氣壓評估最關鍵的場景。商業貨機貨艙的氣壓約為地面的75%（約0.75 atm），相當於海拔8,000英尺的環境壓力。這個壓差對多種包裝都有潛在影響：
blocks.en: Air transport is the most critical scenario for pressure assessment. The cabin pressure in the cargo hold of a commercial freighter is about 75% of ground pressure (about 0.75 atm), equivalent to the ambient pressure at an altitude of 8,000 feet. This pressure differential can affect many types of packaging:

blocks.zh: 氣壓風險：預充填注射器的柱塞移動
blocks.en: Pressure risk: plunger movement in prefilled syringes

blocks.zh: 預充填注射器（Prefilled Syringe, PFS）中，低氣壓會造成柱塞向後移動（Plunger Retraction）：
blocks.en: In a prefilled syringe (PFS), low pressure can cause plunger retraction:

blocks.zh: 柱塞後退 → 密封界面暴露於非無菌區域
blocks.en: The plunger moves back, exposing the sealing interface to a non-sterile area

blocks.zh: 極端情況下柱塞可能完全脫出筒身
blocks.en: In extreme cases the plunger can come completely out of the barrel

blocks.zh: 影響程度取決於：充填量、頂空體積、包裝設計、壓差大小
blocks.en: The extent of the effect depends on fill volume, headspace volume, package design and the size of the pressure differential

blocks.zh: 比喻：飛機上的礦泉水瓶
blocks.en: Analogy: a water bottle on an airplane

blocks.zh: 您是否注意到乘坐飛機時，密封礦泉水瓶會因艙壓變化而稍微凹陷？同樣原理，柔性包裝（如袋子）可能「膨脹」，而密封預填充注射器的柱塞可能被「吸出」。這就是為何航空運輸的氣壓評估不可忽略。
blocks.en: Have you noticed that a sealed water bottle dents slightly with the cabin pressure changes when you fly? The same principle applies: flexible packaging (such as pouches) may "inflate", and the plunger of a sealed prefilled syringe may be "pulled out". This is why pressure assessment for air transport cannot be ignored.

blocks.zh: 6.1.3 Testing Approaches | 測試方法
blocks.en: 6.1.3 Testing Approaches

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 第6.1.3節
blocks.en: Commentary — Section 6.1.3

blocks.zh: 使用標準化測試方法（ISTA、ASTM、ICH、ISO）的目的是確保可重現性（Reproducibility），但標準並非萬能：
blocks.en: The purpose of using standardized test methods (ISTA, ASTM, ICH, ISO) is to ensure reproducibility, but standards are not a cure-all:

blocks.zh: 標準的局限性
blocks.en: Limitations of Standards

blocks.zh: ISTA等標準提供的是「通用場景」模擬，可能無法完整重現特定配送網絡的複雜性
blocks.en: Standards such as ISTA provide simulations of "generic scenarios" and may not fully reproduce the complexity of a specific distribution network

blocks.zh: 例如：「先陸運→空運→再陸運」的多模式組合運輸，各段壓力的累積效應標準未必涵蓋
blocks.en: For example, in multimodal transport such as "road, then air, then road again", the standards may not cover the cumulative effect of the stresses in each leg

blocks.zh: 關鍵原則：模擬測試必須反映實際預期的壓力條件，而非盲目套用標準
blocks.en: Key principle: the simulation test must reflect the actual expected stress conditions, rather than blindly applying a standard

blocks.zh: 6.2 100% Online Testing | 100%在線測試
blocks.en: 6.2 100% Online Testing

blocks.zh: In-line CCIT at fill/finish for every container | 充填封口線上對每個容器進行CCIT
blocks.en: In-line CCIT at fill/finish for every container

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 第6.2節
blocks.en: Commentary — Section 6.2

blocks.zh: 100%在線測試（100% In-Line Testing）指在充填封口後，對生產線上每一個容器進行CCIT，不遺漏任何一個。這是「整體性CCI控制策略」的核心環節之一。
blocks.en: 100% In-Line Testing means performing CCIT on every container on the production line after filling and closing, without omitting any. It is one of the core elements of a "holistic CCI control strategy".

blocks.zh: In-line測試的雙向邏輯
blocks.en: The Two-Sided Logic of In-Line Testing

blocks.zh: 通過在線測試 ≠ 保證整個保存期限都維持CCI（後續仍可能因儲存、配送等因素失效）
blocks.en: Passing the in-line test does not guarantee that CCI is maintained throughout the shelf life (the container may still fail later because of storage, distribution and other factors)

blocks.zh: 未通過在線測試 = 確定不符合CCI要求（100%確定淘汰）
blocks.en: Failing the in-line test means the container is definitively non-conforming to CCI requirements (100% certain rejection)

blocks.zh: 因此，在線測試的功能是「過濾器」，將確定缺陷品剔除，但無法保證通過者的長期完整性。
blocks.en: The function of in-line testing is therefore that of a "filter": it removes containers that are definitely defective, but cannot guarantee the long-term integrity of those that pass.

blocks.zh: In-line vs Off-line：成本效益關鍵差異
blocks.en: In-line vs Off-line: The Key Cost-Benefit Difference

blocks.zh: Off-line測試失敗：整批產品被標記為「疑似批次」，需封存、重測、調查，成本高昂
blocks.en: Off-line test failure: the whole batch is flagged as a "suspect batch" that must be quarantined, retested and investigated, at high cost

blocks.zh: In-line測試失敗：僅剔除該單一容器，不影響整批；即時反饋，生產繼續
blocks.en: In-line test failure: only that single container is rejected and the batch is unaffected; feedback is immediate and production continues

blocks.zh: 因此在線測試的最大優勢是消除疑似批次處理成本
blocks.en: The greatest advantage of in-line testing is therefore that it eliminates the cost of handling suspect batches

blocks.zh: 比喻：機場安全檢查
blocks.en: Analogy: airport security screening

blocks.zh: 100%在線CCIT就像機場安全門——每位旅客都必須通過，不抽樣。通過的人不代表一定沒問題（例如隱藏得很好的違禁品），但沒通過的人確定有問題。離線QC測試則像隨機抽查——效率高但存在漏網之魚的風險。
blocks.en: 100% in-line CCIT is like an airport security gate: every passenger must pass through, with no sampling. Passing does not necessarily mean there is no problem (for example, a well-hidden prohibited item), but anyone who fails definitely has a problem. Off-line QC testing is like random spot checks: efficient, but with a risk that some slip through.

blocks.zh: 法規要求
blocks.en: Regulatory Requirements

blocks.zh: 目前歐盟GMP附件1（Annex 1, 2008/2022版）及EudraLex Volume 4明確要求：安瓿（Ampoules）及吹-充填-封（BFS）容器必須進行100%密封完整性檢驗。其他容器類型則依風險評估決定是否需要100%在線測試。
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 (2008/2022 versions) and EudraLex Volume 4 currently state explicitly that ampoules and blow-fill-seal (BFS) containers must undergo 100% container closure integrity testing. For other container types, whether 100% in-line testing is needed is decided by risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 6.3 Building a Quality by Design (QbD) Approach into the CCIT Program | 將QbD導入CCIT計畫
blocks.en: 6.3 Building a Quality by Design (QbD) Approach into the CCIT Program

blocks.zh: Systematic, science-based, risk-driven framework for package integrity | 系統化、科學導向、風險驅動的包裝完整性框架
blocks.en: Systematic, science-based, risk-driven framework for package integrity

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 第6.3節
blocks.en: Commentary — Section 6.3

blocks.zh: QbD（Quality by Design，設計品質）是ICH Q8所定義的系統性開發方法：從預定目標出發，以科學和風險管理為基礎，深入理解產品與製程。將QbD理念導入CCIT計畫，代表不再是被動應對缺陷，而是主動預防。
blocks.en: QbD (Quality by Design) is the systematic development approach defined in ICH Q8: starting from predefined objectives and building a deep understanding of the product and process on the basis of science and risk management. Bringing QbD into the CCIT program means no longer reacting to defects but preventing them proactively.

blocks.zh: QbD CCIT計畫建構流程
blocks.en: Building a QbD CCIT Program

blocks.zh: 建立QTPP：定義產品-包裝系統的品質目標（含CQAs）
blocks.en: Establish the QTPP: define the quality objectives of the product-package system (including CQAs)

blocks.zh: 識別CMAs & CPPs：找出影響包裝完整性的關鍵材料屬性與製程參數
blocks.en: Identify CMAs & CPPs: find the critical material attributes and process parameters that affect package integrity

blocks.zh: 定義MALL：依產品品質需求設定最大允許洩漏限值
blocks.en: Define the MALL: set the maximum allowable leakage limit according to product quality requirements

blocks.zh: 建立CCIT工具組：選擇覆蓋全生命週期各階段的測試方法組合
blocks.en: Build the CCIT toolbox: select a combination of test methods covering every stage of the lifecycle

blocks.zh: 設計控制策略：制定抽樣計畫、接受標準、變更控制觸發機制
blocks.en: Design the control strategy: establish the sampling plan, acceptance criteria and change control triggers

blocks.zh: 持續改進：將CCIT數據納入包裝完整性概況資料庫，定期審查
blocks.en: Continual improvement: feed CCIT data into the package integrity profile database and review it periodically

blocks.zh: 確定性 vs. 概率性方法選擇
blocks.en: Choosing Between Deterministic and Probabilistic Methods

blocks.zh: 確定性方法（Deterministic）：基於可預測的物理現象（如氦氣洩漏率、真空衰減），結果定量、客觀，需較少準備
blocks.en: Deterministic methods: based on predictable physical phenomena (such as helium leak rate and vacuum decay); results are quantitative and objective, and less preparation is needed

blocks.zh: 概率性方法（Probabilistic）：結果定性，依賴一系列事件發生的概率（如微生物侵入測試）；某些情況下靈敏度更佳，可提供缺陷位置信息
blocks.en: Probabilistic methods: results are qualitative and depend on the probability of a series of events occurring (such as microbial ingress testing); in some cases sensitivity is better, and information on defect location can be provided

blocks.zh: MALL的核心地位
blocks.en: The Central Role of the MALL

blocks.zh: MALL（Maximum Allowable Leakage Limit，最大允許洩漏限值）是整個CCIT計畫的定錨點。所有測試方法的選擇、LOD的要求，都必須以「能可靠偵測到等於或小於MALL的缺陷」為前提。MALL的設定則源自於產品品質需求（如無菌性維持、劑量準確性等）。
blocks.en: MALL (Maximum Allowable Leakage Limit) is the anchor point of the whole CCIT program. The selection of every test method and every LOD requirement must be premised on "reliably detecting defects equal to or smaller than the MALL". The MALL itself is derived from product quality requirements (such as maintaining sterility and dose accuracy).

blocks.zh: 6.3.1 Risk Assessment | 風險評估
blocks.en: 6.3.1 Risk Assessment

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 第6.3.1節
blocks.en: Commentary — Section 6.3.1

blocks.zh: 包裝完整性的風險評估，可借用ICH Q9所介紹的多種工具：
blocks.en: Risk assessment for package integrity can borrow from the various tools introduced in ICH Q9:

blocks.zh: 比喻：Six Sigma DMAIC循環
blocks.en: Analogy: the Six Sigma DMAIC cycle

blocks.zh:
包裝完整性風險評估遵循與Six Sigma類似的循環：
Define（定義）→ 識別製程步驟與材料
Measure（量測）→ 評估失效風險與潛在缺陷
Analyze（分析）→ 列出失效原因與現有控制措施
Improve（改善）→ 制定測試策略，設計控制點
Control（控制）→ 持續監測，建立完整性概況資料庫
blocks.en:
Package integrity risk assessment follows a cycle similar to Six Sigma:
Define → identify process steps and materials
Measure → assess failure risks and potential defects
Analyze → list failure causes and existing controls
Improve → develop the test strategy and design control points
Control → monitor continuously and build the integrity profile database

blocks.zh: 風險評估的兩大影響維度
blocks.en: The Two Dimensions of Impact in Risk Assessment

blocks.zh: 包裝完整性失效的影響不僅限於產品，更涉及患者安全：
blocks.en: The impact of a package integrity failure is not limited to the product; it also concerns patient safety:

blocks.zh: 對產品：污染、氧化、藥效喪失、pH變化
blocks.en: On the product: contamination, oxidation, loss of potency, pH change

blocks.zh: 對患者：感染（微生物侵入）、過量/劑量不足、不良反應
blocks.en: On the patient: infection (microbial ingress), overdose/underdose, adverse reactions

blocks.zh: 6.4 Bulk Container Lifecycle Approach | 大量容器生命週期方法
blocks.en: 6.4 Bulk Container Lifecycle Approach

blocks.zh: Single-use systems: from supplier manufacturing through user deployment | 單次使用系統：從供應商製造到使用者部署
blocks.en: Single-use systems: from supplier manufacturing through user deployment

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 第6.4節
blocks.en: Commentary — Section 6.4

blocks.zh: 大量容器（Bulk Container），特別是單次使用系統（Single-Use System, SUS）如生物製藥中的一次性袋（Bioprocess Bags），其生命週期涵蓋兩大階段，每個階段的測試重點不同：
blocks.en: The lifecycle of a bulk container, particularly a single-use system (SUS) such as a bioprocess bag in biopharmaceutical manufacturing, covers two major phases, each with a different testing focus:

blocks.zh: SUS生命週期兩大階段
blocks.en: The Two Major Phases of the SUS Lifecycle

blocks.zh: 第一階段：開發階段（Development Phase）
blocks.en: Phase 1: Development Phase

blocks.zh: 材料選擇（Material Selection）：工程聚合物的規格與相容性
blocks.en: Material selection: specifications and compatibility of engineered polymers

blocks.zh: 設計確認（Design Qualification）：焊縫、密封設計驗證
blocks.en: Design qualification: verification of weld and seal design

blocks.zh: 供應商端完整性測試：建立完整性保證能力
blocks.en: Integrity testing at the supplier: establishing integrity assurance capability

blocks.zh: 第二階段：產品階段（Product Phase）
blocks.en: Phase 2: Product Phase

blocks.zh: 供應鏈管控：從製造商出貨到用戶接收
blocks.en: Supply chain control: from shipment by the manufacturer to receipt by the user

blocks.zh: 用戶端使用前、使用中、使用後測試
blocks.en: Testing by the user before, during and after use

blocks.zh: 最終產品無菌性的支持性佐證
blocks.en: Supporting evidence for the sterility of the final product

blocks.zh: 使用前vs.使用後測試的監管意義
blocks.en: The Regulatory Significance of Pre-use vs Post-use Testing

blocks.zh: 使用前洩漏測試（Pre-use Leak Testing）：驗證接收後處理/搬運沒有損害完整性，補充供應商放行測試的保障
blocks.en: Pre-use Leak Testing: verifies that handling after receipt has not compromised integrity, supplementing the assurance given by the supplier's release testing

blocks.zh: 使用後洩漏測試（Post-use Leak Testing）：支持最終產品無菌性聲明（Sterility Claim）——若SUS使用後仍完整，表示整個製程中無外部污染機會進入
blocks.en: Post-use Leak Testing: supports the sterility claim of the final product; if the SUS is still intact after use, there was no opportunity for external contamination to enter during the whole process

blocks.zh: 比喻：從食材到餐桌的冷鏈管理
blocks.en: Analogy: cold chain management from ingredients to table

blocks.zh: SUS的生命週期管理，就像高級餐廳從農場到餐桌的整個供應鏈管理。食材（SUS袋）從農場（供應商）出發，歷經冷藏運輸（入廠前）、廚房儲存（組裝存放）、使用前檢查（目視、漏水測試）、烹飪過程（生物製程使用），以及最後確認（使用後測試）。每個環節都有檢查點，任何一環失效都可能影響最終品質。
blocks.en: Lifecycle management of a SUS is like the supply chain management of a high-end restaurant from farm to table. The ingredients (the SUS bag) leave the farm (the supplier), go through refrigerated transport (before arrival at the site), kitchen storage (assembly and holding), pre-use checks (visual inspection, leak test), the cooking process (use in the bioprocess), and finally a last confirmation (post-use test). Every step has a checkpoint, and a failure at any one of them can affect the final quality.

blocks.zh: 6.5 Educational Simulation: LOD and Method Selection | 教育性模擬：LOD與方法選擇
blocks.en: 6.5 Educational Simulation: LOD and Method Selection

blocks.zh: PharmaCo-A case study — screening, optimizing, and validating four leak-test technologies | PharmaCo-A案例：篩選、優化及驗證四種洩漏測試技術
blocks.en: PharmaCo-A case study — screening, optimizing, and validating four leak-test technologies

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 第6.5節概述
blocks.en: Commentary — Section 6.5 Overview

blocks.zh: 第6.5節以虛構公司PharmaCo-A為案例，生動呈現一個腸外藥品公司如何從開發階段到商業化，完整執行洩漏測試方法的篩選、優化與驗證。這個教育性模擬直接體現了前幾節QbD、MALL、LOD等概念的實際應用。
blocks.en: Section 6.5 uses a fictitious company, PharmaCo-A, as a case study to show vividly how a parenteral drug company carries out the screening, optimization and validation of leak test methods from development through commercialization. This educational simulation directly demonstrates the practical application of concepts from earlier sections such as QbD, MALL and LOD.

blocks.zh: PharmaCo-A 案例進程
blocks.en: The PharmaCo-A Case Progression

blocks.zh: 包裝開發：空包裝驗證符合MALL，確立組件設計參數
blocks.en: Package development: empty packages are verified to meet the MALL, and the component design parameters are established

blocks.zh: 放大生產問題：發現裂縫容器、撕裂密封件等問題，啟動行動計畫
blocks.en: Scale-up problems: problems such as cracked containers and torn seals are found, and an action plan is initiated

blocks.zh: 方法選擇：非破壞性、相容、可用於QA穩定性樣品
blocks.en: Method selection: non-destructive, compatible, and usable for QA stability samples

blocks.zh: 可行性研究：四種技術以陽性/陰性對照族群初篩
blocks.en: Feasibility study: the four technologies are initially screened with positive/negative control populations

blocks.zh: 優化與驗證：最大靈敏度vs.最低誤拒率，評估特異性與穩健性
blocks.en: Optimization and validation: maximum sensitivity vs. lowest false rejection rate, and evaluation of specificity and robustness

blocks.zh: LOD確認與精確度驗證：見下方LOD研究詳述
blocks.en: LOD confirmation and accuracy verification: see the LOD study detailed below

blocks.zh: 陽性對照 vs 陰性對照
blocks.en: Positive Controls vs Negative Controls

blocks.zh: 陰性對照（Negative Controls）：已知無洩漏的包裝；用於驗證「方法不誤報好品（Accuracy）」
blocks.en: Negative Controls: packages known to be leak-free; used to verify that "the method does not falsely reject good product (accuracy)"

blocks.zh: 陽性對照（Positive Controls）：已知有特定尺寸缺陷的包裝；用於驗證「方法能偵測到特定大小的缺陷（LOD）」
blocks.en: Positive Controls: packages with known defects of a specific size; used to verify that "the method can detect defects of a specific size (LOD)"

blocks.zh: PharmaCo-A使用雷射鑽孔（Laser-Drilled）缺陷作為陽性對照，因為尺寸可控、可重現、可獨立認證
blocks.en: PharmaCo-A used laser-drilled defects as positive controls because the size is controllable, reproducible and can be independently certified

blocks.zh: LOD預定義標準的重要性
blocks.en: The Importance of Predefined LOD Criteria

blocks.zh: PharmaCo-A在研究開始前就預先定義LOD接受標準：「在所有測試日，最小缺陷尺寸子集中95%以上被偵測為洩漏，即為偵測限。且所有大於此尺寸的缺陷必須100%被偵測。」這種預先定義避免了事後調整標準的偏見，是GxP研究的正確做法。
blocks.en: PharmaCo-A predefined the LOD acceptance criterion before the study began: "The detection limit is the smallest defect size subset in which 95% or more are detected as leaking on all test days, and all defects larger than this size must be detected 100% of the time." Predefining the criterion avoids the bias of adjusting it after the fact, and is the correct practice for a GxP study.

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — LOD結果分析
blocks.en: Commentary — LOD Results Analysis

blocks.zh: 方法A的兩難困境與解法
blocks.en: Method A's Dilemma and Solutions

blocks.zh: 方法A的LOD最佳（6 µm），但存在少量誤拒好品（False Positive）。PharmaCo-A提出兩個方向：
blocks.en: Method A has the best LOD (6 µm) but falsely rejects a small number of good units (false positives). PharmaCo-A proposed two directions:

blocks.zh: 方向一：降低靈敏度，減少誤拒率。LOD可能從6 µm變為接近6 µm，對於MALL評估影響有限
blocks.en: Option 1: reduce the sensitivity to lower the false rejection rate. The LOD might change from 6 µm to a value close to 6 µm, with limited impact on the MALL assessment

blocks.zh: 方向二：維持原始設定，接受一定誤拒率，但為QA穩定性樣品建立「重複測試確認」協議，以避免虛假調查
blocks.en: Option 2: keep the original settings and accept a certain false rejection rate, but establish a "repeat test confirmation" protocol for QA stability samples to avoid spurious investigations

blocks.zh: 方法C的調查教訓
blocks.en: Lessons from the Method C Investigation

blocks.zh: 第2天，3個20 µm缺陷未被偵測，原本會使方法C的LOD確認失敗。但後續調查發現這3個包裝的缺陷是堵塞的（Clogged），因此這些數據被合理排除。這展示了：數據異常應調查根本原因，而非直接廢棄數據。調查後，方法C的LOD可確認為10 µm，但日間結果差異仍引發可靠性疑慮。
blocks.en: On day 2, three 20 µm defects were not detected, which would have caused the LOD confirmation of Method C to fail. A subsequent investigation found, however, that the defects in these three packages were clogged, so the data were justifiably excluded. This shows that anomalous data should be investigated for root cause rather than simply discarded. After the investigation, the LOD of Method C could be confirmed as 10 µm, but the day-to-day variation in results still raised concerns about reliability.

blocks.zh: LOD定義的統計邏輯（β-Content概念）
blocks.en: The Statistical Logic of the LOD Definition (the β-Content Concept)

blocks.zh:
PharmaCo-A的LOD標準：
  - 在所有測試日
  - 最小尺寸子集中 ≥95% 的陽性對照被偵測
  - 且所有更大尺寸缺陷 100% 被偵測

這等同於統計容忍區間（Tolerance Interval）的概念：
β-Content（例如 95%）= 期望偵測比例
信心水準（Confidence Level）= 研究跨日數據的統計可信度

實際應用：
  LOD ≤ MALL → 方法被認可
  LOD > MALL → 方法靈敏度不足，需更換或優化
blocks.en:
PharmaCo-A's LOD criterion:
  - On all test days
  - ≥95% of the positive controls in the smallest-size subset are detected
  - and 100% of all larger defects are detected

This is equivalent to the concept of a statistical tolerance interval:
β-Content (for example, 95%) = the expected detection proportion
Confidence Level = the statistical credibility of the data across the days of the study

In practice:
  LOD ≤ MALL → the method is accepted
  LOD > MALL → the method is not sensitive enough and must be replaced or optimized

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 最終決策與案例啟示
blocks.en: Commentary — Final Decision and Case Takeaways

blocks.zh: 最終，方法A被選定並實施於：（1）例行製造的批次監控；（2）QA穩定性樣品的完整性驗證。商業化獲批後，持續累積的方法A數據成為包裝完整性概況資料庫的一部分。
blocks.en: In the end, Method A was selected and implemented for (1) batch monitoring in routine manufacturing and (2) integrity verification of QA stability samples. After commercial approval, the continually accumulating Method A data became part of the package integrity profile database.

blocks.zh: 案例學習問題
blocks.en: Case Study Questions

blocks.zh: 如果PharmaCo-A的MALL設定為5 µm，方法A（LOD=6 µm）是否可接受？為什麼？
blocks.en: If PharmaCo-A's MALL were set at 5 µm, would Method A (LOD = 6 µm) be acceptable? Why?

blocks.zh: 方法B雖無誤拒問題，但LOD 20 µm。在什麼產品或容器情境下，20 µm的LOD可能仍然可接受？
blocks.en: Method B has no false rejection problem, but its LOD is 20 µm. In what product or container situations might an LOD of 20 µm still be acceptable?

blocks.zh: 如果方法C的日間變異過大，你會如何嘗試找出根本原因？（提示：操作人員、設備、環境、包裝因素）
blocks.en: If the day-to-day variation of Method C is too large, how would you try to find the root cause? (Hint: operator, equipment, environment, package factors)

blocks.zh: PharmaCo-A為何選擇雷射鑽孔缺陷而非製程中自然產生的缺陷作為陽性對照？
blocks.en: Why did PharmaCo-A choose laser-drilled defects rather than defects occurring naturally in the process as positive controls?

blocks.zh: 案例的核心啟示
blocks.en: Key Takeaways from the Case

blocks.zh: 沒有完美的方法：每種技術都有取捨（靈敏度 vs. 特異性 vs. 穩健性）
blocks.en: No method is perfect: every technology involves trade-offs (sensitivity vs. specificity vs. robustness)

blocks.zh: 預先定義標準：LOD接受標準必須在研究前設定，避免事後偏見
blocks.en: Predefine the criteria: LOD acceptance criteria must be set before the study to avoid bias after the fact

blocks.zh: 調查異常數據：方法C第2天異常後的根因調查，是科學誠信的體現
blocks.en: Investigate anomalous data: the root cause investigation after the Method C day-2 anomaly is an example of scientific integrity

blocks.zh: 整合入生命週期：選定方法後，其數據持續納入包裝完整性概況資料庫，支持商業化後的持續監控
blocks.en: Integrate into the lifecycle: once a method is selected, its data continue to feed the package integrity profile database, supporting ongoing monitoring after commercialization

blocks.zh: TR86's contribution to package integrity science and practice | TR86對包裝完整性科學與實踐的貢獻

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 第7.0節
blocks.en: Commentary — Section 7.0

blocks.zh: TR86的結論提煉了整份報告的核心精神：沒有萬能的CCI測試方法，但風險導向的方法加上現有技術的靈活運用，可以有效管理包裝完整性風險。
blocks.en: The conclusion of TR86 distills the core spirit of the whole report: there is no universal CCI test method, but a risk-based approach combined with flexible use of available technologies can manage package integrity risk effectively.

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — QbD決策流程逐步說明
blocks.en: Commentary — Step-by-Step Explanation of the QbD Decision Flow

blocks.zh: 將QbD整合到CCIT計畫，意味著將「測試品質（Test Quality In）」的被動思維，轉換為「設計品質（Design Quality In）」的主動思維。以下是七步決策框架的中文詳解：
blocks.en: Integrating QbD into the CCIT program means shifting from a reactive mindset of "testing quality in" to a proactive mindset of "designing quality in". The seven-step decision framework is explained in detail below:

blocks.zh: 步驟1 — 定義QTPP與CQAs
blocks.en: Step 1 — Define the QTPP and CQAs

blocks.zh: 「品質目標產品概況（QTPP）」是QbD的起點。它定義了「這個產品最終要達到什麼標準」，而CQAs則是具體的品質屬性清單。在包裝完整性的語境下，CQAs包括：無菌性維持、防氧化保護、頂空氣體完整性等。
blocks.en: The Quality Target Product Profile (QTPP) is the starting point of QbD. It defines "what standard the product must ultimately achieve", while the CQAs are the specific list of quality attributes. In the context of package integrity, the CQAs include maintenance of sterility, protection against oxidation, headspace gas integrity and so on.

blocks.zh: 步驟2 — 確定MALL
blocks.en: Step 2 — Determine the MALL

blocks.zh: MALL（最大允許洩漏限值）的設定方法取決於產品特性：
blocks.en: How the MALL (maximum allowable leakage limit) is set depends on the product characteristics:

blocks.zh: 注射劑（無菌要求）：透過微生物侵入研究，確定哪個孔徑尺寸允許微生物通過
blocks.en: Injectables (sterility requirement): determine through microbial ingress studies which orifice size allows microorganisms to pass

blocks.zh: 凍乾製品：依據殘留水分對效期的影響，設定水蒸氣滲透率限值
blocks.en: Lyophilized products: set a water vapor transmission rate limit based on the effect of residual moisture on shelf life

blocks.zh: 氧敏感製品：依據氧化速率，設定氧氣滲透率限值
blocks.en: Oxygen-sensitive products: set an oxygen transmission rate limit based on the oxidation rate

blocks.zh: CO₂充填製品：依據頂空CO₂濃度需求，設定氣體洩漏率限值
blocks.en: CO₂-filled products: set a gas leak rate limit based on the headspace CO₂ concentration requirement

blocks.zh: MALL設定的直觀理解
blocks.en: An Intuitive Understanding of MALL Setting

blocks.zh: MALL就像一個「紅線」：一旦包裝的洩漏程度超過這條線，產品品質就會受到不可接受的影響。你的測試方法LOD必須比這條線更靈敏——只有能「看到」紅線之前的問題，才算是有效的監控工具。
blocks.en: The MALL is like a "red line": once the leakage of a package exceeds this line, product quality is affected unacceptably. The LOD of your test method must be more sensitive than this line; only a method that can "see" problems before the red line is crossed is an effective monitoring tool.

blocks.zh: 步驟3 — 失效模式分析的實務重點
blocks.en: Step 3 — Practical Points of Failure Mode Analysis

blocks.zh: 在FMEA/HACCP分析中，包裝完整性最常見的高風險失效模式包括：
blocks.en: In FMEA/HACCP analyses, the most common high-risk failure modes for package integrity include:

blocks.zh: 注射劑瓶：壓蓋力不足（Residual Seal Force不達標）→ 滾邊/壓蓋製程為CPP
blocks.en: Vials: insufficient crimping force (residual seal force out of specification) → the crimping/capping process is a CPP

blocks.zh: 預充填注射器：柱塞安裝不當→ 密封失效或劑量不準確
blocks.en: Prefilled syringes: improper plunger placement → seal failure or inaccurate dose

blocks.zh: 單次使用袋：焊縫強度不足→ 蠕變或破裂
blocks.en: Single-use bags: insufficient weld strength → creep or rupture

blocks.zh: 卡式瓶：橡膠塞刺穿後復原性不佳→ 多次使用後洩漏
blocks.en: Cartridges: poor recovery of the rubber stopper after puncture → leakage after multiple uses

blocks.zh: 步驟7 — 持續改進的觸發機制
blocks.en: Step 7 — Triggers for Continual Improvement

blocks.zh: 以下任何事件應觸發對CCIT工具組的審查：
blocks.en: Any of the following events should trigger a review of the CCIT toolbox:

blocks.zh: 包裝組件或材料變更（新供應商、新批號規格）
blocks.en: Changes to package components or materials (new supplier, new lot specification)

blocks.zh: 製程參數變更（壓蓋機調整、充填量變更、滅菌條件變更）
blocks.en: Changes to process parameters (capping machine adjustment, fill volume change, sterilization condition change)

blocks.zh: 穩定性結果出現趨勢（CCIT失敗率上升）
blocks.en: A trend in stability results (rising CCIT failure rate)

blocks.zh: 客戶投訴或市場返回品的完整性問題
blocks.en: Customer complaints or integrity problems in market returns

blocks.zh: 法規更新（如EU GMP Annex 1 2022年修訂）
blocks.en: Regulatory updates (such as the 2022 revision of EU GMP Annex 1)

blocks.zh: Deep Dive: Statistical Concepts in LOD — β-Content and Tolerance Intervals | 深度解析：LOD的統計學基礎
blocks.en: Deep Dive: Statistical Concepts in LOD — β-Content and Tolerance Intervals

blocks.zh: How to establish defensible detection limits using statistical tolerance intervals | 如何使用統計容忍區間建立可辯護的偵測極限
blocks.en: How to establish defensible detection limits using statistical tolerance intervals

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — LOD的統計學基礎
blocks.en: Commentary — Statistical Basis of LOD

blocks.zh: LOD（偵測極限）在洩漏測試中是一個統計性聲明，而非單一測量值。理解其統計基礎對於正確設計和詮釋LOD研究至關重要。
blocks.en: The LOD (limit of detection) in leak testing is a statistical statement, not a single measured value. Understanding its statistical basis is essential for correctly designing and interpreting LOD studies.

blocks.zh: β-Content 容忍區間的直觀理解
blocks.en: An Intuitive Understanding of the β-Content Tolerance Interval

blocks.zh: 當我們說「方法的LOD為6 µm」，真正的意思是：
blocks.en: When we say "the LOD of the method is 6 µm", what we really mean is:

blocks.zh: 如果你拿100個6 µm孔徑缺陷的包裝去測，
blocks.en: If you test 100 packages with a 6 µm orifice defect,

blocks.zh: 在正常操作條件下（不同天、不同操作員），
blocks.en: under normal operating conditions (different days, different operators),

blocks.zh: 至少95個會被正確識別為洩漏。
blocks.en: at least 95 will be correctly identified as leaking.

blocks.zh: 這個「95%」就是β-Content。更嚴格的定義還會要求這個95%在統計上以95%的信心水準達成（雙重95%標準）。
blocks.en: This "95%" is the β-Content. A stricter definition also requires that this 95% be achieved statistically at a 95% confidence level (the "double 95%" criterion).

blocks.zh: 比喻：金屬探測器的靈敏度設定
blocks.en: Analogy: the sensitivity setting of a metal detector

blocks.zh: 機場金屬探測器的LOD類比：「能100%偵測到10克以上金屬，對5克金屬偵測率達95%，對1克金屬偵測率約30%」。洩漏測試的LOD定義與此完全相同——它描述的是方法在不同缺陷「大小」下的偵測概率曲線，而LOD是在這條曲線上選擇一個可接受的操作點。
blocks.en: An LOD analogy with an airport metal detector: "It detects 100% of metal over 10 g, 95% of 5 g metal, and about 30% of 1 g metal." The definition of LOD in leak testing is exactly the same: it describes the detection probability curve of the method at different defect "sizes", and the LOD is the choice of an acceptable operating point on this curve.

blocks.zh: 誤報（False Positive）的實務影響
blocks.en: The Practical Impact of False Positives

blocks.zh: 方法A的誤報率雖然很低（<1%），但對於QA穩定性研究的影響不可忽視：
blocks.en: Although the false positive rate of Method A is very low (<1%), its impact on QA stability studies cannot be ignored:

blocks.zh: 穩定性研究通常樣本量少（每時間點可能只有3-6個），誤報一個就可能觸發OOS調查
blocks.en: Stability studies usually have small sample sizes (perhaps only 3-6 per time point), so a single false positive can trigger an OOS investigation

blocks.zh: OOS調查費時費力，且可能錯誤地質疑產品批次
blocks.en: OOS investigations are time-consuming and laborious, and may wrongly call the product batch into question

blocks.zh: 解決方案：要求陽性結果進行複測（Replicate Testing），並在每次疑似失敗後用已知好品（Master）驗證儀器狀態
blocks.en: Solution: require replicate testing of positive results, and verify the instrument status with a known good unit (master) after every suspected failure

blocks.zh: LOD vs MALL：關鍵不等式
blocks.en: LOD vs MALL: The Key Inequality

blocks.zh:
基本要求：
  LOD ≤ MALL

含義：
  方法必須能可靠地偵測到等於或
  小於MALL的缺陷

實例：
  若 MALL = 10 µm（等效名義孔徑）
  則所選方法的 LOD ≤ 10 µm

  方法A（LOD=6 µm）：合格 ✓
  方法B（LOD=20 µm）：不合格 ✗
  方法C（LOD=10 µm）：邊界合格，
    但需考慮日間穩定性 ⚠

安全裕度建議：
  實務上建議 LOD ≤ 0.5 × MALL
  以提供足夠的方法安全裕度
blocks.en:
Basic requirement:
  LOD ≤ MALL

Meaning:
  The method must be able to reliably detect defects
  equal to or smaller than the MALL

Example:
  If MALL = 10 µm (equivalent nominal orifice size)
  then the selected method must have LOD ≤ 10 µm

  Method A (LOD = 6 µm): acceptable ✓
  Method B (LOD = 20 µm): not acceptable ✗
  Method C (LOD = 10 µm): borderline acceptable,
    but day-to-day stability must be considered ⚠

Safety margin recommendation:
  In practice, LOD ≤ 0.5 × MALL is recommended
  to provide an adequate method safety margin

blocks.zh: 實際驗證研究設計建議
blocks.en: Recommendations for the Design of the Actual Validation Study

blocks.zh: 根據TR86的PharmaCo-A範例，設計LOD驗證研究的建議：
blocks.en: Based on the PharmaCo-A example in TR86, recommendations for designing an LOD validation study:

blocks.zh: 陽性對照選擇：優先使用尺寸可驗證的人工缺陷（雷射鑽孔），範圍從預期LOD的0.5倍至2-3倍
blocks.en: Selection of positive controls: preferably use artificial defects whose size can be verified (laser-drilled), ranging from 0.5 times to 2-3 times the expected LOD

blocks.zh: 陰性對照規模：n≥200（TR86用n=300），確保對誤報率有足夠的統計靈敏度
blocks.en: Size of the negative control set: n≥200 (TR86 used n=300), to ensure adequate statistical sensitivity for the false positive rate

blocks.zh: 測試天數：至少3天（評估日間變異），每天使用新的陽性對照子集
blocks.en: Number of test days: at least 3 days (to evaluate day-to-day variation), using a new subset of positive controls each day

blocks.zh: 操作員數量：至少2名操作員（評估操作員間變異）
blocks.en: Number of operators: at least 2 operators (to evaluate operator-to-operator variation)

blocks.zh: 預先定義標準：在研究開始前，以書面形式固定LOD接受標準
blocks.en: Predefined criteria: fix the LOD acceptance criteria in writing before the study begins

blocks.zh: Distribution Testing Detail: ISTA Standards and Air Transport Pressure | 配送測試詳解：ISTA標準與航空運輸氣壓
blocks.en: Distribution Testing Detail: ISTA Standards and Air Transport Pressure

blocks.zh: Practical guidance on transport simulation testing for package integrity | 包裝完整性運輸模擬測試的實務指引
blocks.en: Practical guidance on transport simulation testing for package integrity

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 配送測試與航空氣壓詳解
blocks.en: Commentary — Distribution Testing and Air Transport Pressure in Detail

blocks.zh: 選擇正確的配送模擬標準，是確保測試「反映真實壓力」的第一步。以下是各標準的中文實務解說：
blocks.en: Choosing the right distribution simulation standard is the first step in ensuring that the test "reflects real stresses". A practical explanation of each standard follows:

blocks.zh: ISTA vs ASTM：如何選擇？
blocks.en: ISTA vs ASTM: How to Choose?

blocks.zh: ISTA 2A/3A：藥廠最常使用，特別是向美國FDA/EMA提交的包裝設計驗證。ISTA 3A更全面，含溫度調整條件，適合國際路線
blocks.en: ISTA 2A/3A: the most commonly used by pharmaceutical companies, especially for package design verification submitted to the US FDA/EMA. ISTA 3A is more comprehensive, includes temperature conditioning, and suits international routes

blocks.zh: ASTM D4169：美國工業界廣泛接受，依「危害概況（Assurance Level）」設計測試強度（Level I/II/III），彈性更高
blocks.en: ASTM D4169: widely accepted by US industry; test severity is designed according to the assurance level (Level I/II/III), which gives greater flexibility

blocks.zh: ISO 4180：國際醫藥法規（如EU MDR/IVDR）較傾向引用，有助於歐盟申報
blocks.en: ISO 4180: more often referenced by international medical regulations (such as EU MDR/IVDR), which helps with EU submissions

blocks.zh: 建議：視主要目標市場選擇對應標準，或同時執行ISTA和ASTM以涵蓋最廣監管範圍。
blocks.en: Recommendation: choose the standard that corresponds to the main target market, or run both ISTA and ASTM to cover the widest range of regulatory expectations.

blocks.zh: 航空氣壓數字的直觀感受
blocks.en: A Feel for the Air Pressure Numbers

blocks.zh: 0.75 atm的壓力相當於站在約2,500公尺（約8,200英尺）的高山上。您是否曾在登高時感到耳鳴（氣壓降低導致耳腔壓力失衡）？預充填注射器的柱塞，面對的就是類似的「壓力失衡」——只不過對象是頂空氣體，而後果可能影響藥品無菌性。
blocks.en: A pressure of 0.75 atm is equivalent to standing on a mountain at about 2,500 meters (about 8,200 feet). Have you ever felt your ears ring or pop when climbing (the lower air pressure unbalances the pressure in the ear)? The plunger of a prefilled syringe faces a similar "pressure imbalance", except that the gas involved is the headspace gas and the consequence can affect the sterility of the drug product.

blocks.zh: 柱塞後退（Plunger Retraction）評估方法
blocks.en: Methods for Evaluating Plunger Retraction

blocks.zh: 評估預充填注射器在航空運輸壓差下的柱塞穩定性，常用以下方法：
blocks.en: To evaluate plunger stability of a prefilled syringe under the pressure differential of air transport, the following methods are commonly used:

blocks.zh: 壓力腔（Altitude Chamber）測試：將PFS置於可控壓力腔，模擬從1 atm降至0.75 atm（或更低）的壓力循環，測量前後柱塞位移
blocks.en: Altitude chamber test: place the PFS in a controlled pressure chamber, simulate a pressure cycle from 1 atm down to 0.75 atm (or lower), and measure the plunger displacement before and after

blocks.zh: X光或CT掃描：非破壞性地量化柱塞位置變化
blocks.en: X-ray or CT scan: quantify the change in plunger position non-destructively

blocks.zh: CCIT前後對比：壓力循環前後進行CCIT，確認密封完整性未受影響
blocks.en: Before/after CCIT comparison: perform CCIT before and after the pressure cycle to confirm that seal integrity has not been affected

blocks.zh: 外觀檢查：確認柱塞未完全脫出筒身
blocks.en: Visual inspection: confirm that the plunger has not come completely out of the barrel

blocks.zh: 多模式運輸的累積壓力效應
blocks.en: Cumulative Stress Effects of Multimodal Transport

blocks.zh: 對於一個從台灣運往美國再轉運歐洲的製藥產品，其配送路線可能涵蓋：
blocks.en: For a pharmaceutical product shipped from Taiwan to the US and then transferred to Europe, the distribution route may include:

blocks.zh: 工廠→機場：陸運（振動、衝擊）
blocks.en: Factory → airport: road transport (vibration, shock)

blocks.zh: 台灣→美國：空運（氣壓循環×1次）
blocks.en: Taiwan → US: air transport (1 pressure cycle)

blocks.zh: 美國倉儲：溫度波動
blocks.en: US warehouse: temperature fluctuation

blocks.zh: 美國→歐洲：空運（氣壓循環×1次）
blocks.en: US → Europe: air transport (1 pressure cycle)

blocks.zh: 歐洲→配送中心：陸運（振動）
blocks.en: Europe → distribution center: road transport (vibration)

blocks.zh: 標準化測試只涵蓋其中部分場景，因此必須根據實際配送路線設計定制化測試方案。
blocks.en: Standardized tests cover only some of these scenarios, so a customized test program must be designed according to the actual distribution route.

blocks.zh: 思考練習
blocks.en: Exercise

blocks.zh: 您的公司準備將一批預充填注射器（1 mL，液體充填）通過空運從台灣運往德國（途經香港）。請思考：
blocks.en: Your company is preparing to ship a batch of prefilled syringes (1 mL, liquid-filled) by air from Taiwan to Germany (via Hong Kong). Consider the following:

blocks.zh: 您會選擇哪個/哪些配送模擬標準？為什麼？
blocks.en: Which distribution simulation standard(s) would you choose, and why?

blocks.zh: 航空運輸部分，您最擔心的風險是什麼？如何設計評估方案？
blocks.en: For the air transport portion, what risk are you most concerned about, and how would you design the evaluation?

blocks.zh: 如果空運後的CCIT顯示5%的包裝密封失效，您會如何進行調查？
blocks.en: If CCIT after air transport shows that 5% of the packages have seal failure, how would you investigate?

blocks.zh: 溫度條件（冷藏2-8°C產品）如何影響整個測試設計？
blocks.en: How do the temperature conditions (a refrigerated 2-8°C product) affect the whole test design?

blocks.zh: Cross-Reference: TR86 in the Regulatory Landscape | 交叉參照：TR86在監管架構中的定位
blocks.en: Cross-Reference: TR86 in the Regulatory Landscape

blocks.zh: How TR86 connects to USP <1207>, ICH Q9, EU GMP Annex 1 and FDA expectations | TR86如何與USP <1207>、ICH Q9、EU GMP附件1及FDA期望相連接
blocks.en: How TR86 connects to USP <1207>, ICH Q9, EU GMP Annex 1 and FDA expectations

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — CCI監管架構全貌
blocks.en: Commentary — The Overall CCI Regulatory Framework

blocks.zh: CCI測試的監管要求分散在多個文件中，理解這些文件的層次關係，有助於建立一個能同時滿足FDA、EMA和PIC/S檢查的完整計畫。
blocks.en: Regulatory requirements for CCI testing are spread across several documents. Understanding the hierarchy of these documents helps in building a complete program that satisfies FDA, EMA and PIC/S inspections at the same time.

blocks.zh: 三層監管文件架構
blocks.en: The Three-Tier Regulatory Document Framework

blocks.zh: 第一層：強制性法規
blocks.en: Tier 1: Mandatory regulations

blocks.zh: EU GMP附件1（2022版）：歐盟市場的強制要求，規定CCIT的最低標準
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022 version): a mandatory requirement for the EU market, setting the minimum standard for CCIT

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 211（美國cGMP）：包裝組件和容器要求的法規基礎
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 211 (US cGMP): the regulatory basis for packaging component and container requirements

blocks.zh: 第二層：官方標準/指南
blocks.en: Tier 2: Official standards/guidance

blocks.zh: USP <1207>、<1207.1>、<1207.2>：美國藥典官方章節，FDA引用
blocks.en: USP <1207>, <1207.1>, <1207.2>: official United States Pharmacopeia chapters, referenced by the FDA

blocks.zh: ICH Q8/Q9：國際協調指南，定義QbD和QRM框架
blocks.en: ICH Q8/Q9: international harmonized guidelines defining the QbD and QRM frameworks

blocks.zh: FDA 2008 CCIT Guidance：穩定性中使用CCIT代替無菌測試的指引
blocks.en: FDA 2008 CCIT Guidance: guidance on using CCIT in place of sterility testing in stability studies

blocks.zh: 第三層：技術指南（最佳實踐）
blocks.en: Tier 3: Technical guidance (best practice)

blocks.zh: PDA TR86（本報告）：複雜包裝系統的深度技術指導
blocks.en: PDA TR86 (this report): in-depth technical guidance for complex packaging systems

blocks.zh: PDA TR27：歷史基礎，已被TR86延伸
blocks.en: PDA TR27: the historical foundation, now extended by TR86

blocks.zh: ASTM/ISTA/ISO測試標準：具體測試方法標準
blocks.en: ASTM/ISTA/ISO test standards: standards for specific test methods

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 2022 — 重要更新要點
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 2022 — Key Updates

blocks.zh: 2022年版Annex 1（自2023年8月強制執行）對CCIT有顯著強化：
blocks.en: The 2022 version of Annex 1 (mandatory since August 2023) significantly strengthens the CCIT provisions:

blocks.zh: 第8.90節：要求所有無菌藥品製造商建立書面的容器密封完整性控制策略
blocks.en: Section 8.90: requires all sterile drug manufacturers to establish a written container closure integrity control strategy

blocks.zh: 第8.91節：要求對密封過程進行製程確效（Process Validation），不只是終產品測試
blocks.en: Section 8.91: requires process validation of the sealing process, not just end-product testing

blocks.zh: 第8.92節：明確要求預充填注射器的密封完整性研究，特別提及柱塞後退風險
blocks.en: Section 8.92: explicitly requires seal integrity studies for prefilled syringes, with specific mention of the plunger retraction risk

blocks.zh: 第8.93節：要求建立持續的包裝完整性監測計畫，並與APR/PQR整合
blocks.en: Section 8.93: requires a continuing package integrity monitoring program, integrated with the APR/PQR

blocks.zh: TR86提供的框架（特別是QbD方法、生命週期方法和LOD研究設計）與Annex 1 2022的要求高度契合。
blocks.en: The framework provided by TR86 (in particular the QbD approach, the lifecycle approach and the LOD study design) is highly consistent with the requirements of Annex 1 2022.

blocks.zh: 監管檢查常見問題準備
blocks.en: Preparing for Common Inspection Questions

blocks.zh: 在GMP檢查中，CCI相關的常見問題包括：
blocks.en: In GMP inspections, common CCI-related questions include:

blocks.zh: 「您的MALL是如何確定的？有什麼科學依據？」（需要有MALL設定的研究報告）
blocks.en: "How did you determine your MALL? What is the scientific basis?" (a study report on MALL setting is needed)

blocks.zh: 「您的CCIT方法的LOD是多少？如何確認它小於MALL？」（需要LOD驗證研究）
blocks.en: "What is the LOD of your CCIT method? How do you confirm that it is below the MALL?" (an LOD validation study is needed)

blocks.zh: 「您的密封製程CPPs是什麼？它們如何影響CCI？」（需要製程確效報告）
blocks.en: "What are the CPPs of your sealing process? How do they affect CCI?" (a process validation report is needed)

blocks.zh: 「您有沒有評估過配送對包裝完整性的影響？」（需要運輸驗證研究）
blocks.en: "Have you evaluated the impact of distribution on package integrity?" (a transport validation study is needed)

blocks.zh: 「最近一次包裝組件變更時，您是否重新評估了CCIT計畫？」（需要變更控制記錄）
blocks.en: "At the most recent change of a package component, did you reassess the CCIT program?" (change control records are needed)
